programmes.name_local: Líneas de crédito Bancóldex para emprendimiento e innovación
programmes.name_en: Bancóldex credit lines for entrepreneurship and innovation
programmes.funder: Banco de Comercio Exterior de Colombia (Bancóldex)
programmes.amount_note: Bancóldex rediscounts subsidised credit lines through commercial banks and also invests through its fund-of-funds programme into Colombian VC funds. Amounts and rates depend on the specific line and the intermediary bank.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling; no start-up specific credit line is listed on the Bancoldex site, general credit portfolio applies.
programmes.reopen_note: Bancóldex launches temporary special lines (for example for climate, women entrepreneurs or specific regions) which close once the allocation is exhausted and are periodically replaced with new ones.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply through a participating commercial bank or financial intermediary.
The intermediary underwrites the credit and rediscounts with Bancóldex.

documents_required.doc: RUT and Cámara de Comercio registration

eligibility.other_note: Colombian companies; Bancoldex funds through intermediary banks and general access requires a company with at least 24 months of operation, so pre-revenue start-ups under 24 months do not qualify. The decision is made by the intermediary, so collateral applies.

programmes.amount_note: Conditionally repayable seed capital (convertible to a grant if targets are met) of up to about 180 monthly minimum wages, historically in the region of COP 200-280 million per project depending on the year's minimum wage and the number of jobs created.
programmes.deadline_note: SENA Fondo Emprender runs many separate national and regional convocatorias; the three national calls on the homepage (No. 152 rural economy, 161 persons with disabilities, 162 indigenous) closed on 30 April 2026. Check the 'Convocatorias vigentes' page for current calls.
programmes.reopen_note: Fondo Emprender publishes numbered convocatorias continuously, including closed and regional windows targeting specific populations (victims of conflict, rural, women). Check the convocatorias list for the one matching your profile.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm eligibility (SENA apprentice, student, graduate or other qualifying population).
Formulate the business plan in the Fondo Emprender platform with a SENA adviser.
Technical evaluation, then execution with an operator; the loan converts to a grant if job and execution targets are met.

documents_required.doc: SENA training certificate or qualifying condition evidence
Full business plan in the platform format

eligibility.other_note: Restricted to defined populations: SENA apprentices and graduates, students and graduates of recognised institutions, and specific vulnerable groups. The business must be new (generally under 12 months of formal operation).

programmes.funder: iNNpulsa Colombia, Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo
programmes.amount_note: iNNpulsa runs a rotating portfolio of calls (scaling, innovation, regional entrepreneurship, migrant and returnee entrepreneurship, sector-specific). Award sizes are set per call, ranging from in-kind acceleration to co-financing of tens or hundreds of millions of Colombian pesos.
programmes.deadline_note: iNNpulsa's Emprendimiento Digital 2026 call closed on 30 April 2026; no call was shown as open on the convocatorias page on 2026-10-05. New calls are posted at convocatorias.innpulsacolombia.com.
programmes.reopen_note: iNNpulsa refreshes its call portfolio continuously under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism. Subscribe on innpulsacolombia.com to be notified of new convocatorias.

procedure_steps.detail: Review the open convocatorias page and pick the call matching your profile.
Submit the application before the closing date or before places run out.
Evaluation and, for co-financing calls, execution agreement with milestone reporting.

documents_required.doc: Colombian RUT and Cámara de Comercio registration

eligibility.other_note: Colombian-registered companies and, for some calls, individual entrepreneurs including migrants, returnees and host communities.

programmes.source_snippet: Convocatorias abiertas de Innpulsa Colombia - Impulsando el emprendimiento y la innovación en Colombia. 65 CUPOS DISPONIBLES

programmes.funder: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Minciencias), Colombia
programmes.amount_note: Minciencias funds business R&D through co-financing calls and through the tax benefit route (deduction and tax discount for qualified science, technology and innovation investment). Amounts are set per call; the tax benefit is capped by an annual national quota (cupo).
programmes.deadline_note: Minciencias publishes calls under the ACTeI 2025-2026 plan; Convocatoria Colombia Inteligente 2026 closed 13 April 2026. Company-specific open calls could not be isolated from the official listing.
programmes.reopen_note: The annual tax-benefit quota (cupo de deducción y descuento tributario por inversiones en CTeI) is opened each year by the Consejo Nacional de Beneficios Tributarios; watch minciencias.gov.co for the window, which is usually mid-year.

procedure_steps.detail: Review the Minciencias convocatorias page for the relevant call.
Register the project in the SIGP platform.
Submit the proposal by the deadline.
Evaluation, and for tax benefits, project qualification then claim in the tax return.

documents_required.doc: Colombian RUT and Cámara de Comercio registration
Project proposal with methodology and budget

eligibility.other_note: Colombian companies, often required to partner with a recognised research group or centre.

programmes.name_local: Beneficios tributarios por inversión en CTeI
programmes.name_en: Tax benefits for investment in science, technology and innovation (Minciencias)
programmes.funder: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Minciencias) with the Consejo Nacional de Beneficios Tributarios
programmes.amount_note: Income-tax credit of 30% of the value invested in R&D, technological development and innovation projects in the period, provided the projects meet the criteria set by the CNBT and the credit does not exceed 30% of the tax payable. Further benefits are listed on the Minciencias page.
programmes.deadline_note: Projects are submitted to Minciencias for approval by the CNBT; check the page for current call windows.

eligibility.other_note: Companies paying Colombian income tax that invest in CTeI projects with an entity recognised by Minciencias; projects must meet the CNBT's criteria and conditions.

programmes.source_snippet: Las inversiones que se realicen en investigación, Desarrollo Tecnológico e Innovación, obtendrán como beneficio descontar de su impuesto de renta a cargo el 30% del valor invertido en el periodo siempre y cuando dichas inversiones cumplan con los criterios y condiciones definidos por el Consejo Nacional de Beneficios Tributarios en ciencia, tecnología e innovación – CNBT y no supere el 30% del impuesto a pagar.
